page.overview:
Who is Booshy?

In the episode, after his Banana Guard host declared that he serves as a conduit for the alien entity known as Booshy, he began to convulse and make spitting noises. After this ended, he closed his eyes and put his hands together, declaring that Booshy had arrived, much to everyone sitting around him's delight. Starchy told Booshy to stop talking so that Tree Trunks could speak, and as she did, Booshy would hold his mouth open and flick his tongue.

Booshy would go on to help Tree Trunks break into Princess Bubblegums candy probe facility so that she could save her alien children. His job was to hold Science while it chewed through the fence. At the end of the episode, he was arrested by the Princess and her Banana Guards, announcing that Earth was his prison.

In the Distant Lands episode "Together Again", his Banana Guard host could be seen to have been one of the many beings to have transcended into the afterlife.

Although it is unknown what Booshy really looks like, his Banana Guard host appears to be a Banana Guard with blue hair instead of melted chocolate. When being possessed by Booshy the Banana Guard's eyes become closed.
